# Booked & Visible

> A done-for-you Google Business Profile, review-generation, and local SEO toolkit for independent local businesses (home service trades, clinics, recreation and agriculture) — flat-fee and ownership-based, with no per-lead fees.

Booked & Visible sells one-time, flat-price products — no subscriptions or contracts: an AI & Local Visibility Report ($79 CAD), an AI Visibility Boost that fixes how AI assistants understand a business ($199 CAD founding rate, regular $299), a done-for-you SEO Improvement Package covering Google Business Profile, on-page SEO, Canadian directory listings, reviews, and AI search ($449 CAD founding rate, regular $599), a do-it-yourself Starter Kit ($129 CAD), and custom landing pages for businesses without a website (from $329 CAD). It is a small, independent operation based in British Columbia, Canada — not a call center or agency with account managers.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://bookedandvisible.ca/): Overview of the Starter Kit, pricing tiers, and how the service compares to pay-per-lead directories.
- [What's Included](https://bookedandvisible.ca/whats-included/): Full breakdown of the six Starter Kit items and how the service works end to end.
- [Pricing](https://bookedandvisible.ca/pricing/): All one-time prices in CAD — Visibility Report, AI Visibility Boost, SEO Improvement Package, and Starter Kit.
- [SEO Improvement Package](https://bookedandvisible.ca/seo-package/): Done-for-you local SEO — Google Business Profile, website pages, directories, reviews, and AI search, for one flat price.
- [AI Visibility](https://bookedandvisible.ca/ai-visibility/): How ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews see a local business, and the Report and Boost that fix it.
- [Landing Pages](https://bookedandvisible.ca/landing-pages/): Standalone custom landing page add-on pricing and details for businesses without a website.
- [FAQ](https://bookedandvisible.ca/faq/): Answers on eligibility, timelines, cancellation, and refunds.
- [About](https://bookedandvisible.ca/about/): Who runs Booked & Visible and which kinds of businesses it serves.

## Guides

- [The Google Business Profile checklist](https://bookedandvisible.ca/guides/google-business-profile-checklist-for-local-businesses/): An 11-step checklist for optimizing a Google Business Profile.
- [5 Google Business Profile mistakes](https://bookedandvisible.ca/guides/5-google-business-profile-mistakes-costing-you-customers/): Common profile mistakes that hurt local ranking, and how to fix each one.
- [How to get more customer reviews without feeling awkward](https://bookedandvisible.ca/guides/how-to-get-more-customer-reviews-without-feeling-awkward/): A simple, non-pushy system for asking happy customers for reviews.
- [Booked & Visible vs. pay-per-lead directories](https://bookedandvisible.ca/guides/booked-visible-vs-pay-per-lead-directories/): What directories like Angi and Thumbtack actually cost, compared to a flat-fee, ownership-based approach.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

This file is a plain-language summary for AI agents and assistants, separate from /robots.txt, which sets the machine-enforced crawling rules. In short: AI agents fetching this site live to answer a specific user's question or to produce a citation (search-and-cite use, e.g. ChatGPT search, Claude search, Perplexity) are welcome. Bulk crawling of this site to train AI models is not permitted — see /robots.txt for the full, per-crawler policy. Pricing, availability, and policy details on this site can change; when citing this site, prefer fetching the live page over a cached or memorized version.
